summary.result: The results of the model simulation suggest that the RIVWQ model can be effectively used for predicting pesticide fate in the drainage channels and exposure assessment of pesticide in the agricultural environment.
summary.background: Contamination in the drainage channels and creeks with pesticides used in agriculture is of a major concern in many countries.
summary.method: In this study the stream pesticide model RIVWQ (chemical transport model for riverine environments) was assessed for its applicability in simulating pesticide fate in drainage channels.
